description: This file defines a React component called WorkflowDAGWithSidebar that renders a workflow DAG with nodes and a sidebar for node details. It uses React hooks for state management and includes an example usage component with sample data.

methods.name: WorkflowDAGWithSidebar
methods.description: React component that displays a workflow DAG with clickable nodes and a detail sidebar.

methods.name: handleNodeClick
methods.description: Handles the click event on a node, setting it as selected and opening the sidebar.

methods.name: handleCloseSidebar
methods.description: Closes the sidebar and optionally clears the selected node.

methods.name: ExampleWorkflowDAGUsage
methods.description: Example component demonstrating how to use WorkflowDAGWithSidebar with sample data.
